title: Interview Problem-Solving Patterns
intro: Problem-solving patterns (fresher level) introduces the DSA patterns a junior interview expects. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the interview-approach framework (how to attack a problem), then recursion (the foundation for several patterns). Frequency counting, two pointers, and sliding window follow as the core patterns, then backtracking and dynamic programming intros at the advanced tier. Common fresher programs close the module.
